name: Swashbuckler
description: A legacy rogue subclass from Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

grants.name: Fancy Footwork
grants.description: A creature you attack with a melee attack cannot make Opportunity Attacks against you for the rest of the current turn, whether the attack hits or misses.

grants.name: Rakish Audacity
grants.description: Add your Charisma modifier to Initiative. You can Sneak Attack a target within 5 feet when no other creature is within 5 feet of you and you do not have disadvantage, even without advantage.

grants.name: Panache
grants.description: As an action, contest Persuasion against Insight for a creature that can hear and understand you. A hostile target that loses has disadvantage attacking others and cannot make Opportunity Attacks against them for 1 minute, ending early if allies harm it or you separate by over 60 feet. A nonhostile target is Charmed for 1 minute, ending if harmed.

grants.name: Elegant Maneuver
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, gain advantage on the next Acrobatics or Athletics check made during the current turn.

grants.name: Master Duelist
grants.description: When an attack misses, reroll it with advantage. Regain use after a Short or Long Rest.
